shots.text: The Verdant Deep was older than the Ring. Its people lived in trees the size of towers, and they forgot nothing.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Giant trees, rope bridges, glow-moss lighting the roots like streets, Deepwood archers.

shots.text: Something hollow had crept in under the canopy. At night it sang.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The glow-moss going dark row by row. Pale violet ghost-lights drifting between the roots, and a tall grey-veiled singer with her mouth open: the Pale Vesper.
